raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-BFA-EconomicOpportunitiesResilience",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "High insecurity and active conflict in project regions may severely restrict field access, threaten community safety, and disrupt intervention activities.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Utilize remote monitoring tools (GEMS, PDM), delegate implementation to local CSOs/NGOs/UN partners, and adopt security SOPs adapted to zone threat levels.",
      "evidence": "high insecurity in some of the areas in which project activities will be conducted"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Burkina Faso's fluid political context could affect operational continuity, institutional leadership, and strategic policy commitments.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Anchor implementation within permanent ministry directorates (MFS), establish a clear Project Implementation Manual, and maintain continuous World Bank supervision.",
      "evidence": "the country's current fluid political situation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Lack of an established PIU with financial management capacity, accounting software, and dedicated FM personnel in MFS risks financial non-compliance and reporting delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified FM specialists before effectiveness, adopt an FM procedures manual, install accounting software, and engage internal/external independent auditors.",
      "evidence": "The assessment found that the MFS currently does not have a PIU with FM arrangements in place, including the absence of FM staff"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Administrative routines and untrained bid committee members in World Bank procurement procedures may lead to substantial procurement process delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit an experienced procurement specialist, establish business standards with defined approval timelines in the PIM, and deliver procurement training to committee members.",
      "evidence": "administrative routines may result in procurement delays, potentially affecting project implementation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Limited market competition in insecure and fragile project areas risks collusive bidding, cost inflation, and failure to award contracts.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply World Bank procurement flexibilities for fragile situations, initiate procurement in accessible areas, and adjust market approach strategies.",
      "evidence": "procurement in fragile areas with few bidders can restrict competition and possibly increase prices and collusion risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Insufficient institutional capacity and experience with major civil works contracts may lead to weak oversight and poor administration of warehouse construction.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop mandatory contract management plans in STEP for prior-review contracts and provide continuous hands-on contract management training.",
      "evidence": "insufficient capacity can lead to poor contract management and administration of big contracts."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "High contextual vulnerability and intervention delivery in fragile settings pose substantial risks of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH).",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement an SEA/SH Action Plan, enforce codes of conduct, hire a GBV specialist, and integrate confidential GM channels linked to survivor support services.",
      "evidence": "SEA/SH risk is Substantial, reflecting the nature of project activities and the vulnerability of the target population"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Marginalized populations including IDPs, female-headed households, and persons with disabilities face potential exclusion from program selection and benefits.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Employ community-validated PMT targeting via the RSU, implement gender-sensitive outreach, and establish an operational Grievance Redress Mechanism within 6 months.",
      "evidence": "exclusion from the project's benefits of certain categories of people such as vulnerable groups including women, youth, people with disabilities, internal displaced populations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Construction of 28 warehouses and rehabilitation of 10 regional centers present occupational health and safety hazards, as well as localized soil/water pollution.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct E&S screening, prepare site-specific ESIAs and Labor Management Plans, and recruit dedicated full-time environmental and social specialists in the PIU.",
      "evidence": "key E&S risks and impacts include water and soil pollution from solid and liquid waste at construction and rehabilitation sites; occupational health and safety"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Recurrent climate shocks such as severe droughts and flooding may destroy productive assets and undermine income-generating activities of vulnerable households.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Promote climate-resilient off-farm IGAs, deliver climate adaptation awareness modules, and maintain a CERC for rapid reallocation of emergency funds.",
      "evidence": "5 out of 10 Burkinabe in rural areas affected at least once by droughts or irregular rainfall patterns"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Lack of current interoperability among existing social protection databases (RSU, CONASUR, Faso Arzeka, WURI ID) can hinder real-time data exchange and targeting efficiency.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define an interoperability architecture strategy in Year 1, establish secure API links with ANSSI/CIL oversight, and update data sharing regulations.",
      "evidence": "Systems not interoperable"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Interministerial fragmentation and involvement of multiple government entities across social protection, disaster management, and agriculture could delay unified program delivery.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a multi-sectoral Steering Committee, operationalize interagency collaboration protocols, and convene regular inter-ministerial planning meetings.",
      "evidence": "Building adaptive social protection that can respond to the needs of the poor as well as to shocks involves multiple government actors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Delays in adopting the Productive Grants Manual or executing grant agreements could block disbursements for economic inclusion activities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize the drafting, approval, and adoption of the Productive Grants Manual prior to initiating grant disbursement activities.",
      "evidence": "no withdrawal shall be made... until and unless the Recipient has: (i) adopted the Productive Grants Manual"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Sharp reductions in external humanitarian funding increase the strain on national emergency structures and shock-responsive social protection systems.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Expand RSU coverage, reinforce CONASUR's logistical/warehouse capacity, and operationalize the HDP triple nexus framework.",
      "evidence": "Recent cuts in humanitarian funding have reduced support for IDPs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Lack of required national identification documents (KYC requirements) among poor beneficiaries, especially female IDPs, may prevent MFI account opening and grant transfers.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Partner with the ministry responsible for security and the WURI project to facilitate National Identity Card issuance and cover account opening fees.",
      "evidence": "obtaining ID document for KYC requirement in opening accounts"
    }
  ]
}
